# dsh-lit-search-mcp
MCP server for academic literature search, citation formatting (GB/T 7714 / APA) and BibTeX generati
on — Crossref + OpenAlex + Semantic Scholar, merged and deduplicated, **no API key needed**.
Thin MCP wrapper over dsh-lit-search (also available as a DeepSeek Harness plugin, a CLI, and a SKIL
CP wrapper over dsh-lit-search (also available as a DeepSeek Harness plugin, a CLI, and a SKILL.md).
## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
| `lit_search` | Keyword search merged across Crossref / OpenAlex / Semantic Scholar, deduplicated b
y DOI, with citation counts. Options: `limit`, `year_from`, `year_to`, `sort` (citations/date/releva

nce). |
| `lit_cite` | Format a citation for a DOI: `gbt7714` (default, Chinese standard), `gbt7714-

numeric`, `apa`, `bibtex`. |
| `lit_bib` | Batch BibTeX entries for a list of DOIs (reports which DO

Is failed). |
| `lit_related` | Related works for a DOI via OpenAlex. |
